about.title: Vladislav Belyavsky
about.bio1: Software engineer with 5+ years of commercial experience, focused on architecture, type safety, and developer experience. I build open-source tools (eslint-plugin-vue-arch, nevernullable) and treat them as a lab for ideas I later apply in production.
about.bio2: My daily stack is TypeScript: frontend with React and Vue, backend with Node.js and Rust. I value code that's easy to read, test, and — when needed — delete. I can ship complex products end-to-end: from Tauri + Rust desktop apps to highload interfaces with real-time data.
about.bio3: Outside of work, I write about design patterns, the intersection of functional programming and practical TypeScript, and lessons from maintaining open-source projects. I'm also developing a browser game to better understand game design and state management.
